changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0084. Allow a circular publication to be stored as a notification so the existing push dispatcher can alert recipients. Index review: no new indexes. CK_Notifications_Type is replaced in place. Performance note: one check-constraint change, no table scan beyond the constraint rebuild.

rollback.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.check_constraints WHERE name = N'CK_Notifications_Type' AND parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'app.Notifications')) ALTER TABLE app.Notifications DROP CONSTRAINT CK_Notifications_Type; ALTER TABLE app.Notifications ADD CONSTRAINT CK_Notifications_Type CHECK (Type IN (N'WorkoutReminder', N'MembershipReminder', N'ChallengeReminder', N'AiRecommendation', N'WorkoutCompleted', N'StaffLeaveUpdate', N'ChatMessage', N'WorkoutPlanUpdated', N'TrainerAssigned', N'ProgressMilestone'));
